title: Opus 4.6 (1M context) hits 'API Error: Rate limit reached' on Max subscription
body:
## Description

Opus 4.6 with 1M context window suddenly started returning `API Error: Rate limit reached` on the Max subscription plan ($200/mo).

## Environment
- **Plan:** Claude Max ($200/month)
- **Tool:** Claude Code CLI (latest)
- **OS:** macOS

## Reproduction
1. Open Claude Code
2. Select model: `claude-opus-4-6` with 1M context
3. Send any message
4. Get `API Error: Rate limit reached`

## What works
- Opus 4.6 **without** 1M context — works fine
- Sonnet 4.6 with 1M context — works fine
- All other model/context combinations — work fine

## What doesn't work
- Opus 4.6 + 1M context — rate limited immediately

## Timeline
Was working earlier today, stopped suddenly. No changes on my end.

## Expected behavior
Opus 4.6 (1M) should be available on Max plan as advertised.
author: in0vik

top_comments.author: in0vik
top_comments.body:
**Update:** Sonnet 4.6 with 1M context has also stopped working now — same `API Error: Rate limit reached` error.

So the issue affects **all models with 1M context**, not just Opus.

- Opus 4.6 + 1M context — rate limited
- Sonnet 4.6 + 1M context — rate limited (was working earlier, just broke)
- Both models without 1M context — still work fine
